# Metric Modulation

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:MetricModulation`](gmeow-MetricModulation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/MetricModulation>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)

A reified relator declaring a transition from one [`MusicalTimeFrame`](gmeow-MusicalTimeFrame.md) to another via a pivot equivalence expressed as a rational pair (e.g. 3/8 = 1/4). The pivot resolution is solver-evaluated ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator)
